title: The Host
author: Stephenie Meyer
summary: Earth has been taken over by gentle alien souls who live inside human bodies. Wanderer is placed in the body of Melanie, a rebel who refuses to fade, and the two women's shared love for the same man complicates everything.
readIf: you like romance-heavy science fiction with a moral question at its heart.
skipIf: you want hard science fiction or a quick pace, since the book is long and slow in places.
